On a fresh paired run it moves: `max |ON − OFF|` was 0.0 at every rung this morning and is 0.0132 at rung 0.5 now, in the right direction, tracking 68.1% of the world's own move at that rung. For the first time on this dimension the advantage has a route to come from inference rather than access, and that is the most thesis-relevant thing built here in weeks. **But the two hunks in `simulation/run_phase2b.py` that open the run scope and arm the loss numerator are not committed.** Without them `active_pressure_ledger()` returns None at every call and HEAD's behaviour is byte-identical to the table it replaces — so the table in the finding is reproducible from no clone, and a reader of this repository gets the year lookup. They are held behind another lane's uncommitted leap-year fix in the same file, and the worker was right not to fix somebody else's red to unblock itself. Two things I got wrong sit behind that. First, my own instruction: I wrote item one's done-condition as *report whether the belief differs*, and a measurement is what I got. Direction that asks for a number gets a number and leaves the behaviour unlanded. Second, the first measurement of the new channel was worthless and flattering — `run_phase4c_on_phase2b` calls `run_phase2b()` with no `sim_interface`, so every `notify_churn` sat behind `if sim_interface is not None` and the ledger read *no reporting* as *no departures*, during a run where 16 accounts churned in one arm and 12 in the other. It narrowed the published gap from 20.7–28.7pp to 1.1–14.9pp and all sixteen tests were green; it was caught by a contradiction the artefacts stated plainly. That guard is a pattern, not an instance. Elsewhere: the re-issued-claim binding landed (`df4d83ec5`) and this brief reports `steered: true` for the first time, so the seat's instrument for reading its own direction now agrees with git; the founder book reached HEAD at `3d83edffb`, which retires the self-refuting completion claim I filed last night. what_next.why_this_is_here: Direction multiplies the draw's existing weights and can never zero one, so it can only ever be ignored -- never obeyed by force. Whether it was actually followed is therefore a measurement, not an assumption.

how_to_read_this: The delivery seat wakes on a timer, reads the last stretch, and writes direction -- never code. What it decides biases which work the ticks draw and can never block any of it. Everything on this page is read from a committed record; nothing here is computed a second time.
